name: Roon Bridge
description: Run the official Roon Bridge on the Kalinka Player server and display track information, artwork, and playback progress. Roon sends audio directly to the local DAC. Requires Linux, a Roon Server and subscription, Node.js 18+, Python 3.11+, and a Kalinka Player server with the external playback API and SDK >=3.7,<4. The proprietary Bridge is downloaded on enable. This independent integration is not Roon Ready certified or endorsed by Roon Labs.

notes: A Roon Server and a Roon subscription are required. Enabling the plugin downloads Roon Labs' proprietary Roon Bridge for this machine; this integration is not Roon Ready certified or endorsed by Roon Labs.
Requires Kalinka Player server 5.6.0 or newer (below 6.0.0), which brings SDK 3.7 and the external playback API. The package depends on Node.js 18 or newer, which apt installs with it.
Roon plays straight to the server's local DAC and bypasses the Kalinka Player renderer; Kalinka Player shows what plays. There is no hardware volume control.
Initial distro allowlist is conservative: Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04. Derivatives must match an explicitly listed OS identity.
